business_domains.description: This domain handles all user account-related capabilities including user registration, authentication (sign-on and sign-off), and account profile management. It encompasses the management of personal information (name, email, address, phone), authentication credentials (username, password), and user preferences such as language preference, favorite product category, banner display options, and personalized product lists. The domain is responsible for validating user identity, maintaining session authentication state, and providing personalized experiences based on stored user preferences. It interacts with the database tables: account, signon, profile, and bannerdata.

This domain manages the entire product catalog and inventory of the pet store. It encompasses the hierarchical organization of products into categories, the management of products within those categories, and the detailed item-level attributes (pricing, supplier, status, attributes). The domain supports browsing the catalog by category, viewing product details, viewing item details, and searching for products by keyword. It also manages inventory tracking, providing real-time stock availability checks for items. It interacts with the database tables: category, product, item, inventory, and supplier.

This domain manages the transient, session-based shopping cart experience for customers. It encompasses the ability to add items to a cart, remove items from the cart, update item quantities, and calculate the subtotal cost of cart contents. It bridges the catalog browsing experience with the order placement process by maintaining a temporary collection of desired items along with their quantities and stock availability status. This domain is session-scoped and does not have direct database persistence — it represents the pre-purchase selection state before an order is committed.

This domain handles the complete order lifecycle from placement to retrieval. It encompasses creating new orders by converting cart contents into persistent order records with full shipping and billing address details, payment information (credit card type, number, expiry), and line items. It manages order status tracking, retrieval of individual orders by ID, and listing all orders for a specific customer. The domain also handles inventory deduction upon order placement and unique order ID generation through a sequence mechanism. It interacts with the database tables: orders, orderstatus, lineitem, and sequence.
